fact: The Liberia Meteorological Service, with Tecnavia SA, completed installation of the EU-funded ClimSA/PUMA2025 Meteosat Third Generation system at Roberts International Airport on 24 October 2025, to receive MTG model data and high-resolution satellite imagery.
The African Union Commission's ClimSA deck lists Liberia among 41 of 49 member states with a PUMA station installed as at 12 May 2026; the station carries satellite imagery.
